attempted_claim: Let C be an associative cone in R^7 with link a closed J-holomorphic curve in S^6, and let s-ind(C) be the stability-index of Bera (2026), Definition 1.5. Does there exist a singular associative cone C, not an associative 3-plane, with s-ind(C) = 0? Classify all such cones up to G2-action, or prove that none exist.
decisive_failure: The investigation is limited by the absence of any general eigenvalue or Morse-index gap theorem for J-holomorphic curves of genus >= 2 in S^6 that are neither special Legendrian nor null-torsion; Bera (2026) proves s-ind >= 1 only for genus-1, null-torsion, and special Lagrangian cones, and records the general non-planar bound as an open conjecture, so the remaining case cannot be closed by local deduction or explicit computation within this pass.
